title: A MIMIC POPS OUT AWAY FROM YOU AND ITS BOX SPINS INTO THE VOID
why: His order: the MIMIC crawler from a looting box pops out AWAY from the player so he can kill it without taking damage, has a different name so he knows where it came from, and the box gets a unique disappear-into-the-void swirl animation. The crawler now comes out on the far side of the box, is named MIMIC, and holds its first bite for a second. The box is spent and spins away in a violet void swirl.
now: A mimic crawler comes out away from you, named MIMIC, and its box spins into the void.
